scope: local isolated gallery API with real SQLite, asset verifier and Token-2022 byte decoders; supplied chain observations

checks: Two positive controls register NFT and meme fixtures through the same API using correctly encoded immutable mint, pointer and metadata bytes. Both use finalized transaction and account reads.
Five structurally encoded metadata variants change only name, symbol, URI, embedded mint or update authority. Each is refused without insertion.
Two encoded pointer variants change metadata address or pointer authority. Both are refused without insertion.
Correct mint bytes under the legacy token-program owner are refused by the actual decoder. A matching issuance instruction from that wrong program is separately refused before account reads.
One wrong private genesis and all three known public genesis identities are refused before transaction/account reads.
A valid-shaped wrong mint and an unknown issuance signature are refused before account reads.
Every negative snapshots all assets, gallery, faucet and counter rows before and after. Rows remain unchanged and gallery remains empty. No test permits a real fetch.
